question: Does a hard source-feasibility boundary improve strict editing Raw@1 where P32.4's soft similarity reward did not?

reward.eligible: valid and non-copy and Morgan similarity >= 0.65
reward.guarantee: in every updated mixed-strict group, an ineligible candidate is below the group mean and therefore has negative RLOO advantage

small_gate.baseline: reuse the exact P32.4 step-000 P29-specialist evaluation
small_gate.data: frozen P25.1 final editing gate: 20 conditions for each of 10 editing tasks
small_gate.decoding: sampled Raw@1, one repeat, temperature 0.8, top-p 0.95, seed 23501
small_gate.full_evaluation: not launched unless the small gate promotes a checkpoint

scope: one-seed small gate; no full Table 2 job is submitted initially
